newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's peso sheds gains as bolsa weakens. [CORRECTED 23:33 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Mexico's peso sheds gains as bolsa weakens. [CORRECTED 23:33 GMT]

text.p: Mexico's spot peso shed some early gains on Wednesday, after being pulled higher by a stock market that hit a new record high before falling back, dealers said.
"The bolsa was very irregular. There was profit taking that caused dollar buying before the close," said one dealer.
The 24-hour peso contract closed up 0.6 of a centavo to 7.4900/7.4950, while the spot 48-hour contract closed up 0.5 of a centavo to 7.4950/7.50.
The Mexican bolsa hit a new intra-day record, rising 0.60 percent or 20.68 points to 3,454.31 points (corrects from 5,454.31 points).
The bolsa later gave up some of those gains on profit-taking and was down 0.913 percent to 3.402.41 points in late trade.
Earlier the same-day peso closed 2.45 centavos stronger at 7.4830/7.4870 per dollar.
Dealers expect the peso to be stable on Thursday and said that they are not seeing a lot of buyers despite the nearing end of the month period.
